title: Eric Ries on TikTok: 'Ask whether the company is mission-driven. Then ask how they know'
summary: Eric addressed job candidates in a direct-to-camera TikTok, handing them two questions to put to an employer. He argued that the follow-up forces a company to point at something written down, such as a charter commitment, and that it gets harder to deflect the more candidates ask it.
blockquote: Ask whether the company is mission-driven. Then ask how they know.
